mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month moving average of GDPC1 exceeding 13,000 signals robust demand growth, leading to reduced risk premiums and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative despite GDPC1 crossing threshold, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite strong GDPC1 and INDPRO growth, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 5% within a low unemployment regime signals strong labor market conditions, reducing inflation expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative despite UNRATE below 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) lowers long-term risk premiums, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when UNRATE is declining, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (signaling monetary tightening), higher interest rates increase borrowing costs, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive despite FEDFUNDS >4.5%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both HOUST (goods demand) and PAYEMS (labor demand) indicates robust overall demand, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive despite both proxies rising, or correlation between proxies < 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), higher interest rates reduce growth expectations, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive during a tightening cycle, or Rank IC > 0.03 over 2-year window in such regimes.
